newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Peregrine to scale down Burma operations.
newsitem.headline: Peregrine to scale down Burma operations.

text.p: Peregrine Capital Myanmar Ltd, a subsidiary of Peregrine Investments Holdings Ltd, said on Saturday it would scale down its operations in Burma.
Peregrine Capital Myanmar will close down its office on or before January 31, but will continue to maintain formal representation in Burma, it said in a statement.

Hong Kong-listed Peregrine said it had expected the Burmese government to embark a wide range of privatisation programmes in 1994. As a result, it opened an office there, hoping to generate income by providing financial advice and assisting in raising capital for state-owned enterprise planning to privatise, it said.
But the privatisation programme did not materialise and there was little evidence to suggest when it would take place, the statement said.

"Peregrine has concluded that in the medium term there is little prospect of Peregrine Capital Myanmar generating a meaningful amount of income from the group's core business activities of corporate finance and investment advisory work".
The company said the group's emphasis on direct investment was focused on China and emerging markets in Southeast Asia, but not Burma. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6441
